narrative:
Summit County has 370,098 registered voters, with 16.7% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 16.9% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 54.3%, a pronounced Democratic lean of 37.4 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 28.0% of registrants.
